capabilities: Two-way sync a vault with a selected Aliyun Drive cloud folder
Plan incremental transfers using local state, sync history, and SHA-1 hashes
Run automatic sync on startup, on a timer, and after saves
Resolve Markdown conflicts with three-way merge and keep unresolved copies
Block abnormal mass deletions and skip auto-renamed duplicate folders
extras: README strongly warns to back up the vault before first sync, use a dedicated remote folder per vault, and clean up legacy duplicate folders when upgrading; the refresh token is a long-lived credential kept only in local plugin data.
problem: Obsidian users who store files in Aliyun Drive have no built-in way to sync a vault across devices without the desktop client or a mirrored local folder.

relations.evidence: sync with a selected folder in the personal Aliyun Drive cloud app
It uses the Aliyun Drive open file APIs through an OpenList refresh token flow

summary: Two-way vault sync plugin that mirrors an Obsidian vault to a selected folder in the personal Aliyun Drive cloud app via its open file APIs.
